source.symbol: Windows 25H2 test-platform build and test-set mappings
source.validation: Exact public Git source at the fixed comparison revision. Claims are static observations. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility validation ran.

text:
windows11-32-25h2/debug:
    build-platform: win32/debug
    build-signing-label: build-signing-win32/debug
    test-sets:
        - gtest-tests
        - mochitest-tests
        - xpcshell-tests

windows11-32-25h2/opt:
    build-platform: win32/opt
    build-signing-label: build-signing-win32/opt
    test-sets:
        - gtest-tests
        - mochitest-tests
        - xpcshell-tests

windows11-32-25h2-shippable/opt:
    build-platform: win32-shippable/opt
    build-signing-label: build-signing-win32-shippable/opt
    test-sets:
        - gtest-tests
        - mochitest-tests
        - xpcshell-tests

# Windows 11 - 64bit - 25H2
windows11-64-25h2/debug:
    build-platform: win64/debug
    build-signing-label:
        by-variant:
            msix: repackage-signing-msix-win64/debug
            default: build-signing-win64/debug
    test-sets:
        - gtest-tests
        - marionette-tests
        - mochitest-tests
        - xpcshell-tests

windows11-64-25h2/opt:
    build-platform: win64/opt
    build-signing-label:
        by-variant:
            msix: repackage-signing-msix-win64/opt
            default: build-signing-win64/opt
    test-sets:
        - gtest-tests
        - marionette-tests
        - mochitest-tests
        - xpcshell-tests

windows11-64-25h2-shippable/opt:
    build-platform: win64-shippable/opt
    build-signing-label:
        by-variant:
            msix: repackage-signing-shippable-l10n-msix-win64-shippable/opt
            default: build-signing-win64-shippable/opt
    test-sets:
        - gtest-tests
        - marionette-tests
        - mochitest-tests
        - xpcshell-tests

windows11-64-25h2-ccov/opt:
    build-platform: win64-ccov/opt
    build-signing-label: build-signing-win64-ccov/opt
    test-sets:
        - marionette-tests
        - mochitest-tests
        - xpcshell-tests

windows11-64-25h2-asan/opt:
    build-platform: win64-asan/opt
    test-sets:
        - mochitest-tests
